files.name: FortressRest.java

help: fortress_rest: before a fortress leg in the Nether, crouch in place and eat or regenerate to full health
lesson: Nether fortress deaths are sudden hits (lava, fire, piglins) that land while the bot is chasing. The one cheap thing the bot controls is starting every fortress leg at full health instead of the median 16, because health only regenerates at 18+ hunger and only while the bot stands still and safe.
summary: fortress_rest: in the Nether, before fortress find/blazes starts, stand still (sneaking) and heal to full when health ≤16, eating first if needed, so each fortress leg starts at 20 HP. Targets fortress DIED.
